name: fig19_emission_rate_greybody
caption: d^2N/(dt d omega) = (1/2 pi) sum (2l+1) Gamma_l / (exp(hbar omega/k_B T_H) - 1) for a single real scalar, computed from the transmission probabilities, compared with blackbody emission from the horizon area and from the geometric-optics capture area. At low frequency the s-wave reproduces the horizon-area blackbody; the integrated scalar power is 7.19 times the horizon-area blackbody power for one bosonic degree of freedom (the geometric-optics blackbody, with emitting area 4 pi b_c^2 = 27 pi r_s^2, gives 27/4 = 6.75 and is reproduced numerically).
